label: t26 = t25 with every effect on a gene below 5 CPM in the context's own controls set to 0 (stage 100 expression_gate, cis head included); trial-01 generator, default seed
claim_type: prediction registered before generation and submission; not a measurement
one_factor: against t25 only the expression_gate block is added; sources, weights, amplitude 1.576, shrinkage, gamma 1, cache r9 and cis head are t25's. With the new stage-100 code and no gate, t25's effects are rebuilt bit-identical (checked 29/09 14:22).

evidence_used.energy: measured 29/09: in A, B and C 71.8%, 70.8% and 67.2% of t25's squared effect sits on the 8,604, 8,907 and 8,409 genes below 5 CPM in the context's controls (processed/basal_sources_2026-09-26.csv columns A/B/C); on t22 72.0%, 72.3%, 66.8%
evidence_used.t23: CP-0042: t23 zeroed 8,247 genes fewer than two universes estimate; officially pds_cosine +0.0109 raw (seed alone +0.0009), fidelity +0.0031, nmae +0.0099 worse, reach -0.0085, Jaccard -0.0018, mean +0.0006. The genes it zeroed below 5 CPM in A/B/C carry about 53% of t22's squared effect (read-only measurement of the bench design, 29/09); the ones it zeroed at or above 5 CPM are the likely cause of the DE losses (interpretation)
evidence_used.detectable: the gate leaves every gene at or above 5 CPM untouched, so the median count of detectable genes (match_detectable, genes >= 5 CPM) is t25's and no rescale is needed
evidence_used.bench_blind: the K562 real-scorer bench scores 7,681 genes and would see about 191 of the genes this gate zeroes (read-only design of R-REV action 4): only the server can say what the gate does to the official members

expected.pds_raw: t25 +0.000..+0.020 (the part of t23's gain that comes from low-expression genes)
expected.nmae_raw: t25 -0.008..+0.008 (lower is better); no systematic loss, since expressed genes are untouched
expected.mse: scaled stays 0 (the energy drops by about 70%, lowering the raw value, still above the zero point)

reading_rule_fixed_before_the_result.t26 >= t25 + 0.005: the gate enters the reference, and the final-set pipeline applies it to D/E/F with their own control CPM (it needs nothing else)
reading_rule_fixed_before_the_result.t26 <= t25 - 0.005: the gate leaves: effects on weakly expressed genes help the official score; examine which members fell
reading_rule_fixed_before_the_result.otherwise: inconclusive within resolution: t25/t22 stay the reference. Members are read descriptively against t23's pattern: pds up with nmae, reach and Jaccard not down would say the DE losses of t23 came from the expressed genes it zeroed (hypothesis to confirm with a second submission, not adopted on one)

rrev_rule_note: R-REV's proposed rule: an expected difference under 0.005 is proposed only for information that only the server gives, and said so. The expected centre here is about +0.004; the information (does removing low-expression effects keep t23's PDS gain without its DE losses) is one the real-scorer bench cannot give (bench_blind).
generator: trial-01 (stage 45, trial-ext-profile), default seed 20260912, as t22 and t25; full shape 300 x 400 x 3
